title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP07-ci — CI cost controls and the base-owned verified change scope
goal: Cut the Actions cost of a pull request run without changing what any gate proves: cancel superseded runs, cache the reviewed packages, run the re-validation schedule monthly, and let the base classify the verified changed set so that records-and-plans pull requests inherit the verdicts of unchanged gate inputs (D28).
acceptanceCriteria: Get-IFXChangeScope.ps1 classifies the changed set from the verified merge base to the explicit head as records-and-plans only when every path is a formal plan document, an authorization record or a decision record, and returns full for an empty changed set, an unrecognized path or any failure.

On records-and-plans the workflow skips the head candidate steps of v3-architecture and both cross-platform legs, and the runner records guardrails as skipped for v3-architecture, the three quality checks and v3-specialized-database; v3-pre-diff, Validate, Pre, HistoricalIntegrity and the G03/G04/G05/Plan04 gates always run.

ci/jobs.json declares the cost controls and the change scope, Invoke-IFXCiContract.ps1 enforces them read-only, Test-IFXCiContract.ps1 and Test-IFXTrustedBase.ps1 -ChangeScopeOnly cover the negatives, the 13 required check names and the ruleset are unchanged, and all 13 required checks pass.
